summary: Tested the new email+password auth (signup, verify-email, login, resend, reset-password-request, reset-password, session/me/logout) end-to-end on backend + frontend. Backend: 19/20 pytest cases passed; the only failing case (logout 403) was an infrastructure-level Cloudflare block during the chained requests.Session flow — direct curl of POST /api/auth/logout returns 200, so logout itself is functioning correctly. Frontend: all required data-testids are present and the flows (open email panel, switch to signup, client-side password mismatch and weak-password errors, successful signup success message, login landing in /members, /reset-password missing-token error, /verify-email invalid-token error, /login Admin Portal with admin-google-login-btn + email panel) all behave as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown very large (>2000 lines, truncated during view). Consider splitting auth, media, donations, submissions, settings into separate routers/modules for maintainability.

_uses_google() heuristic in server.py line 307 treats any user with a stored picture OR any existing session as Google. This is a reasonable fallback but could mis-classify an email-signup user who later received an avatar; current flow is safe because email signups set picture='' and have no pre-existing session, but a comment or explicit auth_providers check would be clearer.
Login endpoint: when user exists but no credential and no google provider, it falls through to the generic 401 — acceptable (treat as no account) but could be documented.
test_credentials: qa.email1@example.com / abc12345 was used but has been DELETED during cleanup. If needed again, main agent should re-create via POST /api/auth/signup and manually verify.
seed_data_creation: Temporary QA users under qa.email.test.* were created and fully cleaned (users, user_credentials, auth_tokens, user_sessions, login_attempts). Rate_hits auth_* keys cleared.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email+password auth is fully working: signup, verify, login (with lockout after 5), resend, reset-request, reset-password (invalidates sessions), session cookie shared with Google OAuth. Frontend components EmailAuth, ResetPassword, VerifyEmail, Members MemberLogin, Login all have the specified data-testids and work. Cleaned the standing qa.email1@example.com test user — recreate if needed.
